title: Netflix Tudum
location: São Paulo, Brazil
description: At tm1, eight sub-sets — from Bridgerton to Stranger Things — for a global fan event broadcast live from Ibirapuera.
program: A global fan event featuring eight themed sub-sets inspired by Netflix productions.
tagline: The universe of series turned into eight scenographic experiences.

title: Google Guides
location: Loja Cartel 011, São Paulo, SP
description: Launch and demonstration of Google Guides for clients and partners, with targeted set-design touches to reinforce the event's and the brand's mood in the chosen space. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Product launch and demonstration for clients and partners.
tagline: Technology and set design in a discovery experience.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project was created for the launch and demonstration of Google Guides for clients and partners. The activation took over Loja Cartel 011 and used targeted set-design interventions to adapt the space to the event's concept.

The proposal emphasized the integration between product presentation, environment, and guest experience. The elements placed in the venue reinforced the brand's identity without altering the chosen space's character, creating a contemporary, welcoming atmosphere.

title: Think with Google
location: MuBE — Brazilian Museum of Sculpture, São Paulo, SP
description: Google event to reveal new developments and attract partners and investors, with sober furniture and the brand's colors to soften the formality of the host building. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Institutional event to present new developments and build relationships with partners and investors.
tagline: Google's identity opening space for new conversations.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project was developed for a Google event focused on presenting new developments and building relationships with partners and investors. The set design took over MuBE and was designed to establish a brand presence within a building of strong architectural identity.

The sober furniture and the application of Google's colors created a counterpoint to the space's formality. The solution balanced the event's institutional character with a more contemporary, clear, and welcoming language.

title: HBO — 10 Years of Brazilian Series
location: Casa Bossa, Shopping Cidade Jardim, São Paulo, SP
description: A party for 400 guests celebrating ten years of HBO's Brazilian series, with a timeline structure to present content and themed set design evoking the comfort and refinement of Brazilian social events. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Corporate party celebrating ten years of HBO's Brazilian series.
tagline: Ten years of stories brought together in one experience.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The set design project was developed for the celebration of ten years of HBO's Brazilian series, in a party for approximately 400 guests. The proposal created a themed environment tied to the comfort and refinement of Brazilian social events.

A timeline-shaped structure was used to present the content and revisit the network's production history. The set design combined information, memory, and atmosphere, turning the brand's history into a spatial experience for guests.

title: Swiss House
location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description: In the same year he took on two projects in parallel, Humberto carried the Swiss flag to the Olympic Games — a running track, a recreational space, and the Omega brand on stage.
program: Brand activation and themed space tied to the Olympic Games, with a running track and recreational area.
tagline: Sport, leisure, and Swiss identity in an Olympic experience.
credits: GTM Cenografia; creative direction by Daltro Mendonça.
paragraphs: The Swiss House — House of Switzerland was part of the official program of the Rio 2016 Olympic Games, on the shore of Lagoa Rodrigo de Freitas. Humberto Resende signed the architecture and development of the space's interactive activations, through GTM Cenografia, under the creative direction of Daltro Mendonça.

Three interactive environments were created for Swiss tourism, a professional-standard running track for the Omega watch brand, and a recreational space for the airlines Swiss Air and Edelweiss Air — bringing together sport, leisure, and brand identity in a single Olympic experience.

title: Coca-Cola / LATAM Christmas Tree
location: Guarulhos International Airport, São Paulo, SP
description: Execution of a Christmas activation for Coca-Cola, LATAM, and TAM at Guarulhos airport: a tree-shaped station where passengers recorded a video delivered, in a suitcase, to a relative before Christmas. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Christmas activation and interactive experience for Coca-Cola, LATAM, and TAM.
tagline: A tree that turned waiting time into connection.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project consisted of executing a Christmas activation for Coca-Cola, LATAM, and TAM at Guarulhos International Airport. The proposal was built around a tree-shaped station, created to engage passengers in an experience of communication and affection during the Christmas season.

In the space, participants could record a video for a family member, which was delivered in a suitcase before the holidays. The activation combined set design, interaction, and emotional content, turning a trip through the airport into a memorable experience.

title: Samsung Galaxy A5 Launch
location: Morro da Urca, Pão de Açúcar, Rio de Janeiro, RJ
description: Launch of the new Galaxy A5 with minimalist decor and targeted elements expressing innovation, bringing the brand's colors to one of Brazil's most famous landmarks. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Product launch and brand experience in an iconic Rio de Janeiro landmark.
tagline: Innovation on stage with Rio as the backdrop.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The launch of the new Samsung Galaxy A5 took place at Morro da Urca, part of the Sugarloaf Mountain complex, in Rio de Janeiro. The proposal adopted minimalist decor, with targeted elements able to express the innovation concepts tied to the product.

The brand's colors were incorporated into the space without competing with the landscape or the importance of the chosen venue. The set design created a dialogue between technology, brand identity, and one of Brazil's most recognized landmarks.

title: Samsung Galaxy A Launch
location: Hotel Fasano, Rio de Janeiro, RJ
program: Launch lounge and brand experience.
tagline: An immersive lounge where technology, light, and movement meet.
paragraphs: For the launch of the Samsung Galaxy A, Humberto Resende took part in creating and designing the lounge, developing a spatial experience aligned with the innovative, contemporary character of the smartphone line. The set design explored an immersive atmosphere, marked by a predominant use of blue, dramatic lighting, and a visual composition inspired by technology, movement, and connectivity.

The space was built from luminous lines, geometric elements, reflective surfaces, and sculptural volumes, creating different framings for the brand and product presentation. A ballerina integrated into the set design reinforced the relationship between technology, the body, and movement, turning the lounge into a sensory, performative experience for guests.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.

title: Facebook Booth
location: Six cities across different Brazilian states
description: Modular booth designed to adapt to three different layout formats, allowing it to be built in different cities across Brazil. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Modular booth and traveling brand activation.
area: Structure designed for three layout formats, built in six different cities.
tagline: One booth, three configurations, and nationwide reach.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project developed a modular booth for the Facebook brand, designed to adapt to three different layout formats. The structure was planned to be built in different cities and accommodate different event configurations.

The modularity preserved the brand's visual identity and experience consistency across different spaces. The proposal combined flexibility, ease of adaptation, and communication unity, ensuring the booth kept its presence even in varied contexts.

title: Renault Suite — Rolling Stones
location: Estádio do Morumbi, São Paulo, SP
description: Renault Duster suite during the Rolling Stones' tour in Brazil. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Brand suite and relationship experience during a concert tour.
tagline: The energy of the Rolling Stones meets the Renault experience.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project was developed for the Renault Duster suite during the Rolling Stones' tour in Brazil. The proposal created an exclusive relationship experience between the brand, its guests, and the context of a major music event.

The set design was designed to integrate Renault's presence into the concert environment, establishing a reception and social area for invited guests. The project brought the vehicle's identity closer to the energy and scale of the international tour.

title: Casa Jaguar
location: Rua Oscar Freire, São Paulo, SP
description: Temporary structure for the launch of the new Jaguar XE in Brazil, with refined details and designer furniture to bring the public closer to the brand's identity. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Temporary space for an automotive launch and public engagement.
tagline: Elegance and design to introduce a new presence.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: Casa Jaguar was conceived as a temporary structure for the launch of the new Jaguar XE in Brazil. The proposal sought to translate the vehicle's sophistication into a space for presentation, relationship-building, and closeness with the public.

The set design used refined details and designer furniture to build an experience coherent with the brand's identity. The space was conceived as an extension of the attributes associated with the car, highlighting elegance, exclusivity, and visual presence.

title: Heineken Up on the Roof
location: Edifício Coruja, Vila Madalena, São Paulo, SP
description: Set design for an open-air cinema session with drink and food areas, custom furniture, and an atmosphere in the brand's colors. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Open-air cinema session with drink, food, and social areas.
tagline: Open-air cinema with the Heineken atmosphere.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The set design was developed for an open-air cinema session, with areas for drinks, food, and socializing. The project took over the rooftop of Edifício Coruja, in Vila Madalena, creating an experience tied to leisure and the brand's relaxed atmosphere.

The custom furniture and the styling in Heineken's colors helped build a striking visual identity. The proposal integrated cinema, food, and lingering time in a single space, turning the venue into a place for gathering and entertainment.

title: Ford Focus 2015 Launch
location: Galeria Baró, São Paulo, SP
description: Presentation of the new Ford Focus to the public, with focused set pieces and themed corners to highlight the vehicle's new features. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Automotive launch with vehicle presentation and themed corners.
tagline: The new Focus presented through experience.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project was created for the presentation of the new Ford Focus to the public, using targeted set design and different themed corners. The proposal organized the space to highlight the vehicle's new features and attributes.

The intervention showcased the product without compromising Galeria Baró's architecture. The environments were arranged to guide guests' experience and establish different points of contact with the launch.

title: Oakley In Residence
location: Rio de Janeiro, RJ
description: Oakley House in Brazil during the Rio 2016 Olympic and Paralympic Games: a multi-use space with a showroom, café, restaurant, bar, lecture and course area, and cultural activities. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Brand house and multi-use space with a showroom, café, restaurant, bar, lectures, courses, and cultural activities.
tagline: A house to experience the brand beyond the product.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: Casa Oakley was created in Brazil during the Rio 2016 Olympic and Paralympic Games as a multi-use space for the brand. The project brought together a showroom, café, restaurant, bar, an area for lectures and courses, plus cultural activities.

The diversity of functions turned the venue into a gathering place during the Games. The proposal brought together product, culture, food, and content in a spatial experience able to welcome different audiences and activities.

title: Oakley Sales Meeting 2016
location: Hotel 115, São Paulo, SP
description: Styling of the showroom rooms and social areas for Oakley's sales meeting, bringing the brand's spirit to the event's overall identity. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Sales meeting with showroom rooms and social areas.
tagline: The Oakley spirit present in every encounter.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project was developed for Oakley's sales meeting, focused on styling the showroom rooms and the event's social areas. The proposal aimed to carry the brand's spirit into the overall identity of the gathering.

The set design organized the presentation and relationship-building environments in an integrated way, bringing participants' experience closer to Oakley's visual language. The result was a styling geared toward product presentation, information exchange, and living the brand.

title: LG Experience
location: Bienal Pavilion, Parque do Ibirapuera, São Paulo, SP
description: LG's annual event for 500 attendees, with a showroom area for the brand's entire product line. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: LG's annual event with a showroom presenting the brand's full product line.
tagline: A living showroom to present the future of technology.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: LG Experience was developed for LG's annual event, with approximately 500 attendees. The project included a showroom area dedicated to presenting the brand's entire product line.

The spatial layout was designed to ease guest flow and encourage direct contact with the products. The showroom worked as an integrated experience of presentation, demonstration, and relationship-building, reinforcing LG's presence at the event.

title: L'Occitane Activation
location: Shopping Higienópolis, São Paulo, SP
description: Interactive activation for the L'Occitane brand inside a shopping mall, created in partnership with the agency handling the account. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Retail activation and interactive brand experience in a shopping mall.
tagline: An activation that turns the point of sale into an experience.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project consisted of an interactive activation for L'Occitane at a shopping mall. The proposal was developed in partnership with the agency responsible for the account, creating an initiative to bring the brand and the public closer together.

The intervention was designed to encourage visitor participation and expand the brand experience at the point of contact. The set design and the activation's dynamics worked together to create an inviting, accessible presence aligned with L'Occitane's universe.

title: Pantene Fashion Show
location: Hotel Grand Hyatt, São Paulo, SP
description: Event for 500 attendees featuring a fashion show, keynote presentation, product-training area, press room, pocket show, and lounges aligned with the brand's mood. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Corporate event with a fashion show, keynote session, product training, press room, pocket show, and lounges.
tagline: Beauty, content, and relationship-building in one integrated experience.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The event was developed for approximately 500 attendees and brought together a fashion show, keynote presentation, product-training area, press room, pocket show, and lounges. The set design had to organize different functions within a single brand experience.

The environments were aligned with Pantene's visual identity and atmosphere, creating continuity between areas for content, relationship-building, and entertainment. The project combined information, product presentation, and social time in one integrated structure.

title: Lay's and Doritos Booth
location: Cidade do Rock, Rock in Rio, Rio de Janeiro, RJ
description: Booth for selling and giving away Lay's and Doritos products during Rock in Rio. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Promotional booth for product sales and giveaways during a music festival.
tagline: The energy of Rock in Rio in a brand activation.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project developed a booth for selling and giving away Lay's and Doritos products during Rock in Rio. Set within one of the country's largest music festivals, the space needed to establish direct, attractive communication amid a heavy flow of visitors.

The set design was structured to combine product display, visitor service, and promotional dynamics. The proposal brought the brands closer to festivalgoers through an objective, participatory experience integrated into the event's atmosphere.

title: Havaianas Convention 2016
location: São Paulo, SP
description: General concept for the Havaianas convention — four stages across two different venues — and for the brand's main booth at Francal, following the same visual identity. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Corporate convention with four stages across two venues, plus the brand's main booth at Francal.
area: Four stages spread across two venues.
tagline: One identity, four stages, and one integrated experience.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project developed the overall concept for the Havaianas convention, bringing together four stages spread across two different venues. The proposal also covered the brand's main booth at Francal, keeping a unified visual language across the different spaces.

The central challenge was preserving the unity of Havaianas' identity across distinct formats and environments. The solution organized the communication, presentation, and relationship-building elements under a single set-design concept, strengthening the brand's presence throughout the program.

title: Havaianas Swarovski — Christmas Concept 2015
location: Havaianas Concept Store, Rua Oscar Freire, São Paulo, SP
description: Christmas activation celebrating the partnership between Havaianas and Swarovski at the brand's concept store. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Retail activation and Christmas-themed styling celebrating the Havaianas and Swarovski partnership.
tagline: Where the lightness of Havaianas meets the sparkle of Swarovski.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project was developed for the Christmas activation celebrating the partnership between Havaianas and Swarovski. The intervention took over the brand's concept store and was designed to highlight the collaboration between the two companies during the busiest shopping season.

The proposal brought Havaianas' relaxed, Brazilian universe closer to Swarovski's sophisticated, luminous character. The styling reinforced the partnership's presence at the point of sale and created a themed experience for customers.

title: Havaianas Concept — Summer 2015
location: Havaianas Concept, Rua Oscar Freire, São Paulo, SP
description: Summer campaign for Havaianas' concept store: a wall representing Brazil's tropical forests, revealing, through binoculars, animals protected by the NGOs the brand supports. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Retail activation and themed installation about Brazil's tropical forests.
tagline: Brazil's forest became an interactive experience.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The summer campaign for Havaianas' concept store was built around a depiction of Brazil's tropical forests. The project created a themed wall showcasing the richness of the country's wildlife and natural landscape.

Through binoculars installed in the space, visitors could observe animals protected by the non-profit organizations the brand supports. The intervention brought together communication, environmental education, and retail experience in a simple, interactive visual narrative.

title: Chilli Beans SPFW 2015
location: São Paulo Fashion Week, Parque Villa-Lobos, São Paulo, SP
description: Launch of Chilli Beans' Punk Glum collection with Swarovski at São Paulo Fashion Week: an intervention with giant glasses and a Swarovski-studded scepter, plus the full product-presentation styling. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Brand intervention and collection presentation at a fashion event.
tagline: Fashion, attitude, and sparkle on a monumental scale.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project was developed for the launch of Chilli Beans' Punk Glum collection with Swarovski, during São Paulo Fashion Week. The proposal created a high-visual-impact set-design intervention to showcase the collection and the brand's products.

Among the standout elements were an oversized pair of glasses and a Swarovski-studded scepter. The styling combined product communication, art installation, and brand identity in an experience specially conceived for the fashion context.

title: LATAM 1st Anniversary Party
location: Shopping JK, São Paulo, SP
description: Party celebrating the one-year anniversary of the LATAM merger. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Corporate party celebrating LATAM's one-year merger anniversary.
tagline: A new chapter for the brand, celebrated in style.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project was developed for the party celebrating the one-year anniversary of the merger between LATAM and TAM. The event marked an important moment in consolidating the company's new identity and brought guests together for an institutional celebration.

The styling was designed to create a space for gathering and celebration, reinforcing the brand's presence in a relationship-focused context. The set design helped turn the celebration into an experience visually aligned with the company's new chapter.

title: Nissin Store
location: Hopi Hari Park, São Paulo, SP
description: Nissin store at Hopi Hari park, with a clean, contemporary design connecting the lightness of Eastern aesthetics to European-inspired details on the outer façade. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Retail store inside a theme park.
tagline: Eastern lightness in dialogue with European architecture.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project developed a Nissin store at Hopi Hari Park, with a clean, contemporary design proposal. The architecture was designed to establish a clear, attractive visual presence within a leisure environment of heavy traffic and strong visual stimulus.

The composition combines the lightness of Eastern aesthetics with European-inspired details on the outer façade. The result is a commercial space that integrates brand identity, functionality, and an architectural language suited to the park's context.

title: Marisa Fashion Show
location: Yacht Clube Santos, São Paulo, SP
description: Fashion show for Marisa's summer collection launch, with an outdoor-festival mood — vibrant colors and rustic elements set against a neoclassical building, for a folk-themed decor. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Fashion show and summer collection launch.
tagline: A folk summer amid vibrant colors and classical architecture.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project was developed for the fashion show launching Marisa's summer collection. The proposal drew from an outdoor-festival atmosphere, with vibrant colors and rustic elements adapted to the neoclassical architecture of Yacht Clube Santos.

The set design created a contrast between the building's formality and the decor's folk language. The result was a relaxed, expressive styling, able to establish a visual relationship between the collection's spirit, the chosen venue, and the audience's experience.

title: Obrigado Booth — APAS 2016
location: São Paulo, SP
description: Booth for the Obrigado brand at the APAS 2016 trade fair, with a space evoking the brand's natural, light, beach-inspired mood. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Trade-fair booth and brand experience for APAS.
tagline: Coastal lightness translated into brand experience.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project developed the Obrigado brand's booth for the APAS 2016 trade fair. The proposal sought to spatially translate an identity tied to the coast, nature, and lightness, creating a welcoming presence within the fair's commercial environment.

The set design used a natural, relaxed visual language to bring visitors closer to the brand. The result was a space for communication and relationship-building aligned with Obrigado's positioning and the context of a trade fair.

title: IBBCA Booth
location: Itaparica Island, BA
description: A complete overhaul of the brand's booth visual identity, with minimalist design and a sober color palette for a modern, understated concept. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Brand booth and trade exhibition.
tagline: Minimalism that repositions the brand in space.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project marked a complete overhaul of IBBCA's booth visual identity. The proposal adopted a minimalist design, with a sober color palette and a contemporary language, giving the brand a more current presence.

The set design was developed to convey modernity and sophistication without excess. The combination of formal simplicity, color choices, and spatial organization resulted in a more understated, clear environment aligned with the company's new visual positioning.

title: PICPLAST Booth
location: São Paulo, SP
description: Creative development of a booth for a trade fair in São Paulo, based on the client's brief. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Exhibition and relationship booth for a trade fair.
tagline: A brand presence that's clear, functional, and memorable.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The project consisted of the creative development of a booth for a trade fair in São Paulo, based on the brief presented by the client. The proposal was structured to establish a clear, attractive brand presence in a high-traffic environment.

The scenographic solution organized communication, reception, and visitor experience within a space built for short visits and high exposure. The project sought to translate the brief's guidelines into an objective, functional, and visually consistent spatial experience.

title: Swiss Delux Hotels Convention
location: Casa Bossa, Shopping Cidade Jardim, São Paulo, SP
description: Convention for the Swiss Delux luxury hotel chain, with conceptual decor and refined furniture arranged in lounges for a noble, minimalist air. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Corporate convention and relationship event for a luxury hotel chain.
tagline: Hospitality translated into lounges of minimalist elegance.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The set design project was developed for the convention of the Swiss Delux luxury hotel chain. The proposal created an elegant, conceptual atmosphere suited to the brand's positioning and its guests' profile.

The furniture was arranged in lounges, creating different areas for lingering and relationship-building. The composition adopted a noble, minimalist language, balancing comfort, sophistication, and clarity in the event's organization.

title: Innocean São Paulo Agency
location: São Paulo, SP
description: Renovation and styling of the Innocean agency's headquarters in São Paulo, with a relaxed, youthful language to express the agency's irreverent, creative mood. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Renovation and styling of a corporate headquarters and creative office.
tagline: The agency's creative personality translated into space.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: The renovation and styling of Innocean's headquarters, in São Paulo, was guided by building a relaxed, contemporary language aligned with the company's creative profile. The project sought to spatially translate the agency's irreverent, youthful personality.

The intervention prioritized creating environments capable of encouraging interaction, idea-sharing, and workflow. The architecture became an extension of the brand's identity, balancing functionality, communication, and visual expression.

title: Arena Campos
location: Campos do Jordão, SP
description: Temporary multi-use structure for the Campos do Jordão winter festival, designed to house cinema, restaurants, parties, and different commercial segments while attracting sponsors. Project by Casa Caucaia, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski.
program: Temporary multi-use structure for a winter festival, with cinema, restaurants, parties, and commercial operations.
tagline: A temporary space to experience winter in multiple forms.
credits: Casa Caucaia; creative direction by Renato Kubliokwski.
paragraphs: Arena Campos was conceived as a temporary multi-use structure for the Campos do Jordão Winter Festival. The space was planned to host different activities, including film screenings, restaurants, parties, and commercial operations.

Beyond serving different audiences and formats of use, the structure was designed as a platform for sponsor presence. The proposal combined flexibility of use, cultural purpose, and brand-activation potential in a single temporary space.

title: MUSIVA Event House
location: Cuiabá, MT
description: Renovation and expansion of a 1,000 m² nightclub into a 2,000 m² space (plus 2,500 m² outdoors), with clean design and a lighting system that transforms the atmosphere to suit different types of events, from theater to nightlife. Project with Zeca Paniago.
program: Nightclub and multi-use venue for theater, parties, and different event formats.
area: 2,000 m² (21,500 sq ft) indoors and 2,500 m² (27,000 sq ft) outdoors; original area of 1,000 m² before the expansion.
tagline: A space that transforms for every type of event.
credits: Casa de Eventos Musiva; project with Zeca Paniago.
paragraphs: The project consisted of renovating and expanding a nightclub of roughly 1,000 m² into a 2,000 m² space, plus a 2,500 m² outdoor area. The intervention was designed to increase the venue's capacity and serve different formats of use.

The architectural language adopted a clean, contemporary aesthetic, complemented by a lighting system capable of transforming the atmosphere. This way, the space can take on varied configurations, from theater to concerts and parties, while keeping flexibility and identity.

title: TELEVIDEO Communications Agency
location: Cuiabá, MT
description: Project for the headquarters of a communications agency in Cuiabá, with a sun-shading brise-soleil on the façade and a reception designed for a calm atmosphere with natural light and little reliance on artificial climate control — architecture built for practicality and controlled cost.
program: Corporate headquarters for a communications agency.
tagline: Comfort and efficiency for a communications-driven architecture.
paragraphs: The project for the headquarters of the Televideo communications agency was developed from the need to create a functional, comfortable environment suited to the routine of a creative company. The proposal prioritized architectural solutions that were feasible to build and cost-controlled.

On the façade, the brise-soleil helps reduce solar exposure and improve the building's performance. In the reception area, natural light creates a calmer, more welcoming atmosphere, reducing dependence on artificial climate control and reinforcing the relationship between comfort, efficiency, and spatial quality.

title: 8 de Abril Linear Park Canal
location: Cuiabá, MT
description: Proposal to channel and requalify the 8 de Abril Stream, in Cuiabá, creating a linear park roughly 3.9 km long — a bike path, leisure areas, and green spaces to prevent flooding and give the city back a quality public space.
program: Linear park and urban requalification, with a bike path, green areas, and leisure spaces.
area: 3.9 km (2.4 mi) along the banks of the 8 de Abril Stream.
tagline: A new park to reconnect city, water, and life.
paragraphs: The project proposes channeling and requalifying the 8 de Abril Stream, in Cuiabá, with the creation of a linear park roughly 3.9 kilometers long. The intervention includes a bike path, green areas, and spaces for leisure and community life, strengthening the population's relationship with the stream's surroundings.

Beyond helping prevent flooding, the proposal aims to give the city a qualified, accessible public space integrated into everyday urban life. The infrastructure also takes on an environmental, landscape, and social role, promoting mobility, permanence, and the appreciation of the territory.
